en.html_title: Óscar Castro · QA Lead / QA Manager
en.meta_description: Óscar Castro, QA Lead and QA Manager in Santiago, Chile. 15+ years leading QA teams and test automation for OTT streaming, credit reporting and consulting clients. ISTQB certified.
en.work_intro: A few projects that show the range: building products, testing them on every screen, and automating the checks.

work.title: A product ecosystem for a three-branch business
points: Built the whole stack in house: web front end, an iOS app in production, an Android app, the backend and API, and an internal wiki.
Booking platform in production across three branches, with online payments (Webpay, Flow, Getnet) and WhatsApp, ManyChat and CRM integrations.
A RAG customer chatbot tested like a product: question banks and chat scripts checked retrieval accuracy and answers before each release.

work.title: OTT quality on every screen
points: Tested streaming apps for FOX, HBO and Universal on Smart TVs and CTV, Android TV, Apple TV, set-top boxes, game consoles, mobile and web.
Led automation projects on Witbe, Suitest, Playwright and Robot Framework, the device-lab tooling built for Smart TV testing.
Ran a distributed team of 6 to 8 QA engineers across Chile, Brazil, Mexico and Europe, and set the QA standards used across projects.

work.title: Test automation from roadmap to pipeline
points: Grew a client's automated support suite from 70 to 183 scenarios in one month across a five-target browser and device matrix.
Built a three-layer GitHub Actions pipeline (health, smoke, regression) with a sanity gate, a verdict job and scheduled daily regression.
Built a Playwright reporting framework with visual regression for Nexstar Digital's video player: VAST/VMAP ads, playback, captions, ABR and GraphQL metadata.

en.contact_note: LinkedIn or email is the best way to reach me. I'm based in Santiago, Chile (UTC-3) and work remotely with teams across the Americas and Europe.
